title: Zishen Chan profile
content: Zishen Chan builds AI-enabled software products, portfolio tooling, automation systems, and developer workflows. His work emphasizes practical agentic systems, reliable evaluation, and user-facing product polish.
summary: AI-focused software engineer building portfolio projects, automation, and LLM systems.

title: Personal AI
content: Personal AI is a portfolio chatbot that answers questions about Zishen using a Gemini-powered RAG pipeline. It detects function calls, synthesizes search queries, retrieves portfolio knowledge, validates actions, and generates final answers.
summary: Gemini RAG chatbot for portfolio Q&A and controlled function calls.

title: Remainder API
content: Remainder API supports reminder creation and scheduling workflows. It is integrated into the portfolio chatbot so users can ask to create reminders through a controlled function-call flow.
summary: Reminder scheduling API integrated with chatbot actions.

title: Automation Manager
content: Automation Manager coordinates repeatable tasks and operational workflows. It focuses on reducing manual effort with structured automation and clear control surfaces.
summary: Workflow automation project for repeatable operational tasks.

title: Stock AI
content: Stock AI explores AI-assisted analysis for market-related information. It is positioned as an applied AI and data interpretation project, not as financial advice.
summary: AI-assisted stock and market analysis project.

title: Shortcuts
content: Shortcuts showcases personal productivity automations built around Apple Shortcuts and lightweight integrations.
summary: iOS and personal productivity automation examples.

title: Technical skills
content: Zishen works across frontend product engineering, TypeScript and React applications, Python automation, LLM integrations, RAG systems, cloud services, and evaluation harnesses.
summary: Full-stack and AI engineering skills with cloud and evaluation experience.
